_about: The research pipeline as data: an ordered list, not a graph, because gap closure, theme deltas and re-audit all repeat. A step is offered until its done_when check passes, so a loop is simply a step offered again. `next` is a function of the manifest and the disk alone, so it survives any crash or lost session. type: script (the orchestrator runs it), agent (the engine runs it), cio (a judgment step in the main session). {run} is the run directory.

steps.title: Validate the company's identity and the price, write the brief and the source register
Index the exchanges and the IR site, build the document map, fetch the structured filings (needs the symbols and IR pages)
Find the documents the map lacks
Build the ten-year timeline of major events
Select the sector modules that apply
Write the questions that decide this investment, as questions only
Plan the reading stage
Read every in-scope page and build the dossiers and the coverage record
steps.run: python3 scripts/agent_driver.py reading {run} && python3 scripts/reading.py dossiers {run} && python3 scripts/reading.py status {run} --strict

steps.title: Plan the web digest
Record what web summaries say about each document
Page-confirm the digest and build the packs
steps.run: python3 scripts/digest.py confirm {run} && python3 scripts/digest.py build {run} && python3 scripts/digest.py status {run} --strict

steps.title: Write the identity block every specialist receives
Run the specialists, each verified as it finishes
Verify the research
Collect every gap, close the closable ones, record the rest
The completion barrier
Commit the specialists' work
Merge the ledgers and reconcile the numbers
steps.run: python3 scripts/merge_ledgers.py {run} && python3 scripts/reconcile_numbers.py {run} && python3 scripts/evidence_stats.py {run} && python3 scripts/claim_graph.py build {run}

steps.title: Build the registry and run the theme analysts
Audit the claims and adjudicate every contradiction candidate
Value the company on the forecast and answer every follow-up request
The CIO's own independent analysis
Run the four layer analysts
steps.run: python3 scripts/agent_driver.py synthesis {run} --step layers && python3 scripts/synthesis.py packet {run}

steps.title: Classify, score, reach the reasoned verdict, set the decision outputs
Put the draft verdict to adversarial review, whichever way it points
Run the section writers
Assemble the report and run the integration checks
steps.run: python3 scripts/synthesis.py assemble {run} && python3 scripts/synthesis.py integration {run}

steps.title: Audit who read what, on which model
The independent audit
Resolve every audit finding, re-audit any Critical
Verify everything, the CIO's ledger included
steps.run: python3 scripts/merge_ledgers.py {run} && python3 scripts/verify.py run {run} --stage final

steps.title: The final automated checks
Complete the quality-control record
Finalize: scoreboard, pointer, decision record
Keep the run's transcripts
Commit the final batch
